title: Greek Tarts with Banana Cream Filling
description: A classic Greek dessert featuring flaky tarts filled with a creamy banana filling.

ingredients.name: jucy
ingredients.notes: replaced with honey or sugar if needed

instructions: Bake tart shells for 12-15 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Let tarts cool completely on a wire rack.
Peel bananas and slice into 1-inch pieces.
In a blender, combine sliced bananas, jucy syrup, and greek yogurt. Blend until smooth.
Fill each tart shell with the banana cream mixture.
Chill tarts in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh mint leaves if desired.
